requirements.quote:
Definition: Local system administrator manually starts the peer
                     connection.
requirements.condition: The local administrator manually starts the peer connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent this administrative event as Event 1 (ManualStart).
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
Status:     The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be set
                     to FALSE.
requirements.condition: Event 1 (ManualStart).
requirements.required_behavior: The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

                     connection.

requirements.required_behavior: Represent this administrative event as Event 2 (ManualStop).
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote: Status:     No interaction with any optional attributes.
requirements.condition: Event 2 (ManualStop).
requirements.required_behavior: Have no interaction with optional attributes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Interact with optional attributes as part of ManualStop.
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
Definition: Local system automatically starts the BGP
                     connection.
requirements.condition: AutomaticStart is supported and the local system automatically starts the BGP connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the automatic start as Event 3 (AutomaticStart).
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
Status:     1) The AllowAutomaticStart attribute SHOULD be set
                        to TRUE if this event occurs.
requirements.condition: Event 3 (AutomaticStart) occurs.
requirements.required_behavior: The AllowAutomaticStart attribute SHOULD be TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
2) If the PassiveTcpEstablishment optional session
                        attribute is supported, it SHOULD be set to
                        FALSE.
requirements.condition: Event 3 (AutomaticStart) occurs and PassiveTcpEstablishment is supported.
requirements.required_behavior: The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
3) If the DampPeerOscillations is supported, it
                        SHOULD be set to FALSE when this event occurs.
requirements.condition: Event 3 (AutomaticStart) occurs and DampPeerOscillations is supported.
requirements.required_behavior: The DampPeerOscillations attribute SHOULD be FALSE.
requirements.why_checkable: The event dispatch and associated session attribute state can be inspected and exercised.
